reviews_captured_by_me.text:
I recently had an issue with our glass shower door not closing properly, and I needed a handyman service that was experienced with glass materials. I reached out to ARM Home Care, and Tom sent Don and his partner.
Don recommended a solution that was minimally invasive which made me feel confident he wasn't trying to  up-sell me. Don and his partner completed the repair efficiently and even took the time to clean up my bathroom afterward, which I really appreciated.
I've already called ARM Home Care back for additional projects.I highly recommend Tom and his team for anyone needing reliable and expert home care services!

I have experience seeking professionals for minor home projects and other major projects including  additions. One of the most heightened stresses of this process is finding a trust worthy contractor. Tom and his colleagues Don and Carlos made my recent projects easy. They are very simple to work with and very transparent. I will keep them on speed dial for future work! Do not hesitate to work with them, at least get a quote. They are very competitive and super nice. Thanks for a great experience this far!

I have hired Tom many times  for all kinds of projects around my home. Tom is excellent  at answering calls. If he has to track down a part for the job he certainly will. True professional.  That does excellent work.  I highly recommend giving ARM Home Care a call for your next home project!
